name: Markus Weidner
headline: Lead Backend Engineer
summary: Lead Backend Engineer with 11 years of experience designing and operating scalable distributed systems. Specialized in Java-based microservices, container orchestration with Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Skilled at leading engineering teams, driving architectural decisions, and mentoring engineers to deliver reliable, high-throughput backend platforms.

responsibilities: Lead a team of 8 backend engineers building payment processing microservices
Define technical roadmap and architecture standards for backend platform
Drive migration of monolithic services to Kubernetes-based microservices on AWS
Conduct code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers
Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams on system scalability and reliability
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for logistics tracking platform
Migrated legacy services to containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes
Optimized database queries and caching strategies to improve API response times
Participated in on-call rotation and incident response for production systems
Developed backend services for e-commerce order management system
Implemented unit and integration tests to ensure code quality
Worked with cross-functional teams to define API contracts
Supported deployment pipelines using Jenkins and basic AWS services
